I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread. Nothing he or that channel can see confirms an Osprey rollout site at Quarrendon Freight Lines, so Bay 24 can't be confirmed or ruled out. I'm treating it as unverified and won't pass it on as fact.

I also told him Quarrendon Freight Lines is a North team account owned by Dana Okafor, so Dana or the North team should confirm the site.
